parameters.help_en: The ID of the Service Mesh (ASM) instance
parameters.name: service_mesh_id

parameters.help_en: The trust domain. If both the namespace and the service account are specified, the default value is cluster.local. Otherwise, this parameter is ignored

parameters.name: trust_domain

parameters.help_en: The namespace. This parameter takes effect only when both the namespace and the service account are specified. Otherwise, it is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间。在同时填写命名空间和服务账号时生效，否则将被忽略
